findings.problem: Label word 'effort' left in English; it is not a token (the {value} list is). The ur relay surface already names this concept «استدلال کی شدت» (relay.chrome.model.effort).

«محفوظ شدہ» reads as 'saved', not 'archived', so the parenthetical gloss is needed to rescue it; «گفتگو(ئیں)» is an awkward slash-plural. Neighbour wire.slash.archive frames archiving as hidden from lists.

The English rows (relay/installed/identity) pad labels so every value starts at the same column (14). The ur padding was copied per-row without re-aligning: values start at col 13 (ریلے), 15 (انسٹال شدہ), 11 (شناخت), so the panel's column is ragged. Same for installed_row/relay_* rows.
findings.suggested: Re-pad as a set to a common column, e.g. '  شناخت:      {identity}' / '  انسٹال شدہ: {value}' / '  ریلے:       …'

findings.problem: «منسوخ شدہ» = 'cancelled'; the marker means replaced by a newer question. Acceptable per sidecar, but «بدل دیا گیا» states the actual reason.
The value is now always plural, so it reads «تمام 1 گفتگوئیں» when total=1. The English '(s)' has the same problem and there is no ICU arm, so this is acceptable.
findings.disposition: open at PASS: minor/nit accepted, value unchanged
